latin: Qui sciuerit quid sit denarius in Arithmetica formali, et cognouerit naturam primi numeri spherici, sciet illud quod ego adhuc apud aliquem Cabalistam non legi, et est quod sit fundamentum secreti magni Iobelei in Cabala.
latin_note: The 1486 print reads 'formabili' where the Emendationes errorum itself corrects to 'formali'; the 1487 print already carries the emended reading (farmer1998:27945).
translation: Whoever knows what the ten is in formal arithmetic, and understands the nature of the first spherical number, will know something I myself have not yet read in any Cabalist: the foundation of the Cabala's great secret of the jubilee.
translation_note: A 'spherical number' (5 or 6) is one whose powers always end in that same digit; the 'great jubilee' is a standard name for the third sefirah, one of whose names is Teshuvah (farmer1998:27954).
